title: Render the master mix
summary: File > Render Full Mix... renders every unmuted track exactly as you hear it, to the project or to a file; Export Full Mix as WAV... goes straight to a file.
alternateQueries: How do I export my song?
How do I bounce to WAV?
Why is my MIDI track silent in the render?
How long should the tail be?

steps.instruction: Click into the Tracker and choose File > Render Full Mix...
Choose what to render: the entire project, or a custom start and end.
Set the tail (0 to 120 seconds) so reverbs and delays can finish ringing out.
Choose the sample rate (the audio device's by default) and bit depth, and an optional peak normalise (to -0.3 dB or -1 dB).
Choose Save to: the project (as a render asset) or a file on disk; optionally place the result on a new track.
Enter a name; $project and $date are filled in.

steps.expectedResult: A progress window shows the time rendered, the time elapsed and an estimate, with Cancel.

blocks.text: MIDI instrument tracks are not included in a render yet. The dialog tells you when the project has MIDI clips.
Export Full Mix as WAV... opens the same dialog set to save a file.
